title: Sales by region and category
objective: Total sales that match both a region and a category with SUMIFS and criteria cells.
instructions: The sales list is in A1:D13. In G2:G5, use SUMIFS to total the Sales (K) (column D) for the Region in column E and the Category in column F on the same row. Fix the three list ranges with $ signs and point the criteria at the cells in E and F, so one formula works on every row. One combination has no sales: that is fine, show whatever SUMIFS returns.
hints: SUMIFS starts with the numbers to add: =SUMIFS(what to add, where to look 1, match 1, where to look 2, match 2).
What to add is $D$2:$D$13. The first condition looks in Region ($B$2:$B$13) for E2; the second looks in Category ($C$2:$C$13) for F2.
Copy the same formula down to G5. The list uses lower case in a couple of places; matching ignores case.
